text: Teaching Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks.
